findingDetails.title: The closeout child records the packet as not closing while every other document says Complete
findingDetails.claim: Closure statement says Closeable: No and Not started, metadata Status says Draft, while all six criteria rows are Met, the child implementation-summary says Complete and the parent phase map marks all eleven phases Complete.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Strict validator passes over this text per the same file's AC-003; grep for closable/closure in both decisions.txt files returns nothing, so no waiver exists; the operator-push hold does not explain a negative closeability.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Criteria rows were filled in but the closure section, which has no row and no validator rule, was never revisited.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A decision record or the spec-kit contract declaring the CLOSURE STATEMENT section non-normative until a separate close-out step.

findingDetails.title: Four closed phase children still carry a Draft acceptance-criteria status
findingDetails.claim: Children 001-004 record Status: Draft (and 001 also Closeable: No) while 005-010 record Complete and the parent map marks all Complete.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: No Unmet row in any of the eleven children, so no criterion is open; the parent map and each implementation-summary do agree, so AC-006 is satisfied as written.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Untouched scaffold in the earliest-authored children.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Status on acceptance-criteria is a document-lifecycle field (Draft/Accepted) rather than a completion field.

findingDetails.title: The proof's word-count row is the one row whose command is not named, and the obvious counter does not reproduce it
findingDetails.claim: proof.md records SKILL.md at 4,904 words of 5,000; wc -w returns 4,972. Every other row in the same table names its command.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: The 5,000 ceiling may be measured by a repository word counter with different rules; at 4,972 the file is under the cap by wc -w too, so the gate outcome is identical either way.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The count was taken before the final edit and not re-run.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If 4,904 is what the repository document validator reports for this file, the row is correct.
